notes: Fiscal year ended September 27, 2026 (Starbucks fiscal 2026; matches data.js fy 'Sep 2026'); this edition skips FY2025. Sources: FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0000829224-26-000162, filed November 12, 2026) and the latest proxy, the 2026 DEF 14A (accession 0001213900-26-007780, filed January 26, 2026; ownership as of January 16, 2026). Cash and stock-comp values match SEC XBRL. HOWARD SCHULTZ is not listed in the 2026 proxy's beneficial ownership table, which covers more-than-5% holders, current directors and nominees, the named executive officers, and the current group. He is not a current director or officer; the proxy mentions him only as a former CEO in the pay-versus-performance table. Under the schema rule for former executives, status is no-reported-stake. That means the proxy reports no holding, not that he owns no shares. 5% HOLDERS: Vanguard (holdings at October 31, 2025), Capital Research Global Investors (June 30, 2025) and Capital World Investors (March 31, 2025), each applied by the proxy to the January 16, 2026 share count; BlackRock, listed at 6.9% in 2025, is no longer in the table. BUYBACKS: none in fiscal 2026 (nor in 2025). GEOGRAPHY: revenues include the Channel Development segment; China revenue fell because Starbucks divested its China retail operations in the third quarter of fiscal 2026 (it keeps a China joint venture investment, now in 'Other countries' long-lived assets). Operating segments (North America, International, Channel Development) are not used.

footprint.notes: Everything is from the FY2026 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended Sep 27, 2026), which now calls stores 'coffeehouses'. The 10-K gives coffeehouse counts by market, not by U.S. state, so usStates is null; none was taken from store-locator data. Company-operated and licensed coffeehouses are kept as separate metrics (the U.S., Canada and the U.K. appear in both tables; they are not added). In the third quarter of fiscal 2026 Starbucks moved its China retail operations to a licensed joint venture: 7,991 coffeehouses transferred from company-operated to licensed, so China now appears only in the licensed table (8,340) and its company-operated count is nil; China long-lived assets fell to $166.7 million. 'All Other' (64 company-operated, 4,350 licensed) and Siren Retail rows are residuals and are not shown. Latin America is the 10-K's licensed grouping with no country list. Employees are approximate: 221,000 in the U.S. and 85,000 outside it (no country split). Long-lived assets are given for the U.S., China, Japan and 'Other countries' (the residual, which includes the China joint-venture investment, is not shown). Sites are the full Item 2 table of material properties: the Shanghai office is no longer listed and was removed; Romeoville, IL and Nashville, TN are new.
